title: Human Skin and Gut Mycobiome and Bacteriome Comprehensive Registry
official: Human Skin and Gut Mycobiome and Bacteriome Comprehensive Registry
summary: Bacterial and fungal microbiota will be different between individual body sites; however, particular microbiome profiles both whole-body and site-specific will be unique to volunteers with a given parameter such as medical diagnosis, diet, medications taken, geographical area; etc.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Capable of giving informed consent.
* Able and willing to complete all required specified study procedures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Antibiotic or antifungal use whether topical or systemic in the past 2 or 4 weeks, respectively.
* Unable and/or unwilling to complete all required study procedures.
